scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/seed.mjs > .seed.sql && wrangler d1 execute drink-status --local --file .seed.sql && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.seed.sql', { force: true })"
scripts.feedback: wrangler d1 execute drink-status --remote --command "SELECT user_label AS who, mood, body, datetime(created_at/1000,'unixepoch','+9 hours') AS at FROM feedback ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.feedback:tally: wrangler d1 execute drink-status --remote --command "SELECT mood, COUNT(*) AS n FROM feedback GROUP BY mood"
